title: Rethinking the Global Convergence of Softmax Policy Gradient with Linear Function Approximation: The Case of Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2505.03155v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Policy gradient (PG) methods have played an essential role in the empirical successes of reinforcement learning. In order to handle large state-action spaces, PG methods are typically used with function approximation. In this setting, the approximation error in modeling problem-dependent quantities is a key notion for characterizing the global convergence of PG methods. We study Softmax PG with linear function approximation (referred to as $\texttt{Lin-SPG}$) and demonstrate that the approximation error is irrelevant to the algorithm's global convergence even in the bandit setting. Consequently, we rethink the effect of approximation error in the standard stochastic multi-armed bandit problem. We first identify the conditions on the policy feature representation that can guarantee the asymptotic global convergence of $\texttt{Lin-SPG}$. translated_title: 重新思考带线性函数逼近的Softmax策略梯度的全局收敛性：多臂老虎机案例
translated_abstract: 策略梯度（PG）方法在强化学习的实证成功中发挥了重要作用。为了处理大规模的状态-动作空间，PG方法通常与函数逼近结合使用。在这种设置下，建模问题相关量时的逼近误差是刻画PG方法全局收敛性的一个关键概念。我们研究了带线性函数逼近的Softmax策略梯度（称为Lin-SPG），并证明了即使在老虎机设置中，逼近误差也与算法的全局收敛性无关。因此，我们重新思考了逼近误差在标准随机多臂老虎机问题中的影响。我们首先确定了能够保证Lin-SPG渐近全局收敛的策略特征表示条件。在这些特征条件下，我们进一步证明了Lin-SPG进行T次迭代……
tldr: 本文研究带线性函数逼近的Softmax策略梯度（Lin-SPG），证明逼近误差与算法的全局收敛无关，并给出了保证其渐近全局收敛的策略特征表示条件。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that the approximation error is irrelevant to the global convergence of Softmax policy gradient with linear function approximation, and identifies conditions on the policy feature representation that guarantee asymptotic global convergence.
